verdict.rationale: Stripe is fundamentally API-first: docs show full programmatic control over payments, billing, subscriptions, refunds, disputes, payouts, tax, and marketplace payouts (Connect), with webhooks for async events and idempotency/versioning for safe automation. It also ships dedicated AI-native tooling—an official MCP server, agent skills repo, and CLI sandbox provisioning—explicitly designed so AI agents can operate via API without the Dashboard.
